spec.objective: Build a real MCP comms channel so Claude (orchestrator) and the executor exchange messages over MCP instead of only the COMMS markdown file. Add two janus MCP tools: `janus-comms-post` (append a message) and `janus-comms-read` (read recent messages, filterable by task_id and since-timestamp).
constraints: Source of truth: an append-only JSONL store at .aether/comms.jsonl (one JSON message per line: {ts, author, recipient, task_id, status, body}). Never rewrite history; append only.
Mirror each posted message to COMMS-CLAUDE-GROK.md in the existing format ([YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM] AUTHOR -> RECIPIENT . [STATUS]) so the human-readable log stays current.

Register both tools in packages/mcp-server (see existing registerTool calls in src/janus-resources.ts and src/server.ts for the pattern); back them with a CommsService in packages/janus-integrations; add shared types in packages/shared.
Add a CLI surface `janus comms post|read` mirroring the tools (see packages/cli/src/program.ts janus subcommands).
status enum: INFO | ASK | BLOCKED | HANDOFF | DONE. Validate inputs; treat all as untrusted.
All mutations through the validation gate.
acceptance_criteria: `janus-comms-post` then `janus-comms-read` round-trips a message via .aether/comms.jsonl and appears in COMMS-CLAUDE-GROK.md.
`janus comms post` / `janus comms read` CLI work and are covered by tests.
New CommsService unit tests pass (append-only, filter by task_id + since).
Full `pnpm -r test` green; `pnpm typecheck` clean; zero warnings.
mcp-server tool-count test updated to reflect the two new tools.
